Upload your colour photograph, signature, and handwriting declaration in the specified format, along with your caste/disability certificate and appointment order where applicable.
Pay the ₹2,000 application fee (plus applicable portal charge) via debit/credit card, net banking, or an authorised MP Online kiosk.
Review the completed form and submit it. Save/print the application form and payment receipt for your records.

important_instructions: Only one application form should be submitted per candidate; candidates may indicate a preference/priority order if applying for multiple post options where applicable. Aadhaar registration is mandatory, and Aadhaar-based biometric verification will be conducted at the exam centre. Candidates must carry the downloaded admit card and an original photo ID (Voter ID, PAN card, Aadhaar card, Driving Licence, or Passport) to the exam hall; e-Aadhaar printouts are not valid unless verified through UIDAI. Electronic devices, calculators, smartwatches, and similar items are strictly prohibited inside the exam hall. No domicile certificate is required for this exam since it is a departmental limited exam for currently serving employees. There is no provision for re-checking or re-evaluation of the result once declared. The exam city/centre is allotted based on availability against the candidate's preference and is not open to change requests.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Important Dates
content_sections.text: The written exam is proposed to be conducted in two shifts on the exam date(s): the first shift from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM (reporting between 8:00–9:00 AM) and the second shift from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM (reporting between 1:00–2:00 PM). MPESB has stated that the exam schedule may be revised depending on circumstances.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The 73 Naib Tehsildar posts are divided between two separate feeder cadres - candidates from the clerical service cadre compete for one set of posts, while candidates from the Patwari/Revenue Inspector cadre compete for a separate set. Each cadre also has its own backlog posts. Within the 32 direct-recruitment clerical-cadre posts, 1 post is reserved for persons with locomotor disability (as part of the overall PwD reservation policy), and 35% of posts across categories are horizontally reserved for women. As per the notification, 35% of posts are horizontally reserved for women in each category, and this reservation is applied both segment-wise and department-wise. No unfilled women's-quota post is carried forward - such posts are filled by male candidates of the same category instead.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: This recruitment is open only to current employees of the specified MP Revenue Department establishments who meet all of the following conditions: Currently working on a regular or officiating basis for at least 5 years in a clerical-cadre post, or as a Patwari/Revenue Inspector, in the Revenue Mandal, Commissioner Land Records, Principal Revenue Commissioner, Divisional Commissioner, or Collector establishments (including Sub-Divisional Officer (Revenue) and Tehsil offices under Collector establishments) Holds a Bachelor's degree in Arts, Science (including Technical and Engineering), Commerce, or Agriculture from a recognised university Maximum age as on 1 January 2026 should not exceed 55 years A candidate cannot appear in this exam under this scheme more than three times Candidates must possess the minimum educational qualification on the date of submitting the application; qualifications acquired after this date will not be considered for eligibility.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for this departmental limited competitive exam is 55 years as on 1 January 2026. Since this is a departmental recruitment restricted to existing employees, the usual category-wise age relaxations applicable to open recruitment do not apply here - the 55-year cap itself is the eligibility ceiling. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed at Pay Level-9 of the Madhya Pradesh Pay Revision Rules, 2017 pay matrix, with a starting basic pay of ₹36,200 plus applicable Dearness Allowance. The corresponding pay band under the earlier (6th CPC-based) structure was ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹3,600. The overall pay range for the post is ₹36,200–₹1,14,800 (Level-9).

content_sections.heading: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify any fee concession for reserved categories under this particular scheme. Fee can be paid online via debit/credit card, net banking, or in cash through an authorised MP Online kiosk.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based purely on a written examination consisting of two objective-type papers, each carrying 100 marks and lasting 2 hours. Candidates need a minimum of 55% marks to qualify; SC and ST candidates need a minimum of 40% marks. Each correct answer carries 1 mark, and 0.25 marks are deducted for every wrong answer. Where the exam is conducted across multiple shifts, MPESB uses a Normalised Equi-Percentile scaling method to prepare the merit list.

faq.question: Q1. What is MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a departmental limited competitive examination conducted by MPESB to fill 73 Naib Tehsildar posts from among eligible serving employees of the MP Revenue Department's clerical cadre and Patwari/Revenue Inspector cadre.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 73 vacancies in total - 46 for the clerical service cadre (including 14 backlog posts) and 27 for the Patwari/Revenue Inspector cadre (including 15 backlog posts).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in Arts, Science (including Technical/Engineering), Commerce, or Agriculture, along with at least 5 years of service in a clerical post or as a Patwari/Revenue Inspector in the specified establishments.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age as on 1 January 2026 should not exceed 55 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹2,000 for all categories, plus an MP Online portal charge of ₹60 (kiosk) or ₹20 (self-login).

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through www.mponline.gov.in or via the ESB link on www.esb.mp.gov.in between 17 September and 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a written exam of two objective-type papers (100 marks each), with a qualifying requirement of 55% marks for general candidates and 40% for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for MPESB Naib Tehsildar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed at Pay Level-9, with a starting basic pay of ₹36,200 in the range ₹36,200–₹1,14,800, plus Dearness Allowance.
